ukiryu_schema.description:
Ukiryu schema format version (now "1.0", future "1.1", "1.2").
Indicates which schema version this profile conforms to.
Recommended for all profiles, especially those using v1.0+ features.

$self.description:
Self-assigned URI of this document (v1.0+).
Format: https://www.ukiryu.com/register/{schema_ver}/{tool-name}/{tool-ver}
Example: https://www.ukiryu.com/register/1.0/git/2.47
Serves as base URI for resolving relative references.
Enables future multi-document definitions.

display_name.description: Human-readable display name for the tool

version_detection.description: Configuration for detecting the tool version

pattern.description: Regex pattern to extract version number

search_paths.description: Platform-specific search paths for the executable

timeout.description: Default timeout in seconds for command execution

components.description:
Register of reusable definitions (v1.2+).
Components must be explicitly referenced to have effect.
Enables sharing common option/argument/flag definitions across commands.

profiles.description: Command execution profiles for different platforms/shells

option_style.description: Default option style for this profile

inherits.description: Name of parent profile to inherit from

routing.description:
Command routing table.
Maps command names to their executable targets.
Enables multi-level hierarchies where each level has its own routing.
Example: { remote: git-remote, branch: git-branch, stash: git-stash }

version_requirement.description:
Semantic version requirement for this profile (v1.2+).
Supports semantic versioning: ">= 2.30", ">= 2.30, < 3.0", "~> 2.45.0"
Used to check if the installed tool version is compatible with this profile.

exit_codes.description:
Exit code definitions for this tool (v1.2+).
Provides machine-readable error semantics.

env_var_sets.description:
Reusable named environment variable sets (v1.2+).
Allows defining common env var configurations that can be applied
to commands by referencing the set name.

Example: A "headless" set for GUI tools:
  env_var_sets:
    headless:
      - name: DISPLAY
        value: ''
        platforms: [macos, linux]
        description: Disable display for headless operation

Commands can then reference these sets via `use_env_vars`.

post_options.description: Options that come AFTER all input files

subcommand.description:
Subcommand phrase for this command.
- Single word: 'convert' for tools like 'magick convert'
- Multi-word: 'get pod' or 'storage account create' for nested subcommands
- Omit this field for tools that execute directly (no subcommand word)

aliases.description:
Alternative names for this command.
Allows the command to be invoked using any of these aliases.
Example: ['ex', 'run'] would allow 'tool ex' and 'tool run' to invoke this command.

belongs_to.description:
Parent command this action belongs to.
Creates hierarchical structure: Tool → Command → Action.
Example: action "add" with belongs_to: "remote" means "remote add"
References a command name in the routing table.

cli_flag.description:
CLI flag that selects this action.
Used when actions are expressed as flags instead of positional args.
Example: git branch -d uses cli_flag: "-d" for the "delete" action.
If omitted, the action name is used as a positional argument.

use_env_vars.description:
Names of env var sets from profile-level `env_var_sets` to apply.
Allows commands to selectively apply predefined environment configurations.

Example:
  use_env_vars: ['headless']

This would apply all env vars from the 'headless' set defined in
the profile's `env_var_sets`. The actual env vars are defined
per-profile since headless requirements vary by tool and platform.

exit_codes.description:
Exit code definitions for this command/action (v1.2+).
Provides machine-readable error semantics specific to this command.

variadic.description: Whether this argument can accept multiple values

position.description: Position in command line ('first' for first, 'last' for final, or integer index)

min.description: Minimum number of values for variadic arguments

cli.description:
CLI flag including prefix (e.g., '--output', '-o', '/format').
This is the unique identifier for the option within a command.
MUST be unique among all options and flags in the same command.

IMPORTANT: The `cli` field must contain ONLY the bare flag name
without any delimiter characters (no '=', no ':', no trailing space).
The `assignment_delimiter` field controls how the value is attached.

Examples:
  cli: "--export-filename"        # CORRECT (bare flag name)
  cli: "--export-filename="       # WRONG (do NOT include '=')

When assignment_delimiter is set, the framework automatically
adds the appropriate delimiter when building the command:
  - cli: "--output" with assignment_delimiter: equals   → "--output=value"
  - cli: "-f" with assignment_delimiter: space         → "-f value"
  - cli: "/format" with assignment_delimiter: colon    → "/format:value"

assignment_delimiter.description:
How the option value is attached to the CLI flag.
IMPORTANT: When using this field, the `cli` field must NOT include
delimiter characters (see `cli` field documentation above).

- 'equals': Value attached with '=' (--flag=value)
- 'space': Value attached with space (--flag value)
- 'colon': Value attached with ':' (/flag:value)
- 'none': No value (boolean-style, flag alone)
- 'auto': Detect based on cli prefix:
  * '--' prefix uses 'equals' (--flag=value)
  * '-' prefix uses 'space' (-f value)
  * '/' prefix uses 'colon' (/format:value)

cli.description:
CLI flag including prefix (e.g., '--verbose', '-v', '/VERBOSE').
This is the unique identifier for the flag within a command.
MUST be unique among all options and flags in the same command.

assignment_delimiter.description:
Flags always use 'none' (no value assignment).
The flag is either present or absent.

cli_short.description: Short form of the CLI flag

position_constraint.description:
Positional constraint for flags that must appear in specific locations:
- 'any' (default): Flag can appear anywhere
- 'prefix': Flag must appear immediately after subcommand (before any options)
- 'after_argument': Flag must follow a specific argument (e.g., find's --and/--or after expressions)
- 'between_expressions': Flag acts as an operator between expressions

position_after.description:
Required when position_constraint is 'after_argument'.
Specifies which argument this flag must follow.

conflicts_with.description:
List of flag names that are mutually exclusive with this flag.
Example: ['quiet', 'silent'] for a verbose flag.
Used by CLI to prevent conflicting options from being used together.

from.description: Parameter name to get value from

platforms.description: Platforms where this env var applies

steps.name: Build with Jekyll
steps.run: bundle exec jekyll build --verbose --trace --baseurl "${{ steps.pages.outputs.base_path }}"

steps.run: bundle exec jekyll build --trace

steps.name: Check if site was built
steps.run:
if [ ! -d "_site" ]; then
  echo "Error: _site directory not created"
  exit 1
fi
echo "Site built successfully"
ls -la _site/

version_bump.description: Type of version bump to apply

custom_version.description: Custom version string (overrides version_bump) - e.g. 2.5.0 or 2.5.0-beta.1

steps.run: git fetch --tags origin

steps.name: Configure Git
steps.run:
git config user.name github-actions
git config user.email github-actions@github.com

steps.name: Bump version and create tag
steps.run:
gem install gem-release
if [ -n "${{ github.event.inputs.custom_version }}" ]; then
  gem bump --version ${{ github.event.inputs.custom_version }} --tag --push
else
  gem bump --version ${{ github.event.inputs.version_bump }} --tag --push
fi

steps.name: Ensure ImageMagick PNG encode delegate
steps.run:
eval "$(brew shellenv)"
brew install libpng
probe="$(mktemp -d)/probe.png"
if ! magick -size 4x4 xc:white "png:${probe}" 2>/dev/null || [ ! -s "${probe}" ]; then
  echo "PNG encode delegate missing — reinstalling ImageMagick against libpng"
  brew reinstall imagemagick
fi
magick -size 4x4 xc:white "png:${probe}"
test -s "${probe}" && echo "PNG encode delegate verified"

steps.name: Create working directory
Configure WinGet
steps.run:
# Bypass certificate pinning for msstore source due to SSL inspection issues
# See: https://github.com/microsoft/winget-cli/issues/2879
winget settings --enable BypassCertificatePinningForMicrosoftStore

steps.name: Install ImageMagick (winget)
steps.run:
Write-Host "Installing ImageMagick via winget..."
winget install --id ImageMagick.ImageMagick --silent --accept-package-agreements --accept-source-agreements

steps.name: Install Ghostscript (winget with Chocolatey fallback)
steps.run:
# Ghostscript x64 installer times out on ARM64 due to emulation
# Skip on ARM since x64 runners already test Ghostscript functionality
if ($env:RUNNER_ARCH -ne "ARM64") {
  Write-Host "Installing Ghostscript..."
  # Ghostscript 10.01.0+ disabled silent install, so winget cannot install it unattended
  # Use Chocolatey as fallback: https://github.com/microsoft/winget-pkgs/issues/267547
  # Requires AutoHotkey for automation: https://github.com/chocolatey-community/chocolatey-packages/pull/2319
  Write-Host "Installing AutoHotkey (required for Ghostscript automation)..."
  Set-ExecutionPolicy Bypass -Scope Process -Force
  [System.Net.ServicePointManager]::SecurityProtocol = [System.Net.ServicePointManager]::SecurityProtocol -bor 3072
  iex ((New-Object System.Net.WebClient).DownloadString('https://community.chocolatey.org/install.ps1'))
  choco install autohotkey.portable -y

  Write-Host "Attempting winget install (will likely fail)..."
  winget install --id ArtifexSoftware.Ghostscript --silent --accept-package-agreements --accept-source-agreements 2>$null
  if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) {
    Write-Host "Winget install failed, using Chocolatey fallback..."
    choco install ghostscript -y
  }
} else {
  Write-Host "Skipping Ghostscript on ARM64 (tested on x64 runners)"
}

steps.name: Install FFmpeg (winget with Chocolatey fallback)
steps.run:
Write-Host "Installing FFmpeg..."
# Try winget first, fall back to Chocolatey if package not found
Write-Host "Attempting winget install..."
winget install --id ffmpeg.ffmpeg --silent --accept-package-agreements --accept-source-agreements 2>$null
if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) {
  Write-Host "Winget install failed, using Chocolatey fallback..."
  Set-ExecutionPolicy Bypass -Scope Process -Force
    [System.Net.ServicePointManager]::SecurityProtocol = [System.Net.ServicePointManager]::SecurityProtocol -bor 3072
    iex ((New-Object System.Net.WebClient).DownloadString('https://community.chocolatey.org/install.ps1'))
  choco install ffmpeg -y
}

steps.name: Install Pandoc (winget)
steps.run:
Write-Host "Installing Pandoc via winget..."
winget install --id JohnMacFarlane.Pandoc --silent --accept-package-agreements --accept-source-agreements

steps.name: Install jq (winget)
steps.run:
Write-Host "Installing jq via winget..."
winget install --id jqlang.jq --silent --accept-package-agreements --accept-source-agreements

steps.name: Install yq (winget)
steps.run:
Write-Host "Installing yq via winget..."
# yq is installed via scoop as it's not available on winget
Set-ExecutionPolicy RemoteSigned -Scope CurrentUser -Force
irm get.scoop.sh | iex
scoop install yq

steps.name: Refresh PATH
steps.run:
$env:Path = [System.Environment]::GetEnvironmentVariable("Path","Machine") + ";" + [System.Environment]::GetEnvironmentVariable("Path","User")
# Add scoop shims to PATH
$env:Path = "$env:USERPROFILE\scoop\shims;" + $env:Path
echo "PATH=$env:Path" >> $env:GITHUB_ENV

steps.name: Verify installations
steps.run:
Write-Host "=== Verifying installations ==="
Write-Host ""
Write-Host "ImageMagick:"
magick --version
Write-Host ""
Write-Host "Ghostscript (Windows uses gswin64c/gswin32c):"
$gsFound = $false
@('gswin64c', 'gswin32c', 'gs') | ForEach-Object {
  if (Get-Command $_ -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue) {
    Write-Host "Found: $_"
    & $_ --version
    $gsFound = $true
  }
}
if (-not $gsFound) {
  Write-Host "WARNING: Ghostscript executable not found in PATH"
}
Write-Host ""
Write-Host "FFmpeg:"
ffmpeg --help | Select-Object -First 3
Write-Host ""
Write-Host "Pandoc:"
pandoc --version
Write-Host ""
Write-Host "jq:"
jq --version
Write-Host ""
Write-Host "yq:"
yq --version

steps.name: Run tests
steps.run: bundle exec rake spec

---
ukiryu_schema: '1.0'
"$self": https://www.ukiryu.com/register/1.0/ghostscript/10.0
name: ghostscript
display_name: Ghostscript PS/PDF Interpreter
homepage: https://www.ghostscript.com/
version: '10.0'
aliases:
- gs
- gswin64c
- gswin32c
profiles:
- name: unix
  display_name: Ghostscript on Unix
  platforms:
  - macos
  - linux
  shells:
  - bash
  - zsh
  option_style: single_dash_equals
  commands:
  - name: convert
    description: Convert PostScript or PDF to other formats
    usage: gs [options] input-file
    options:
    - name: device
      cli: "-sDEVICE"
      type: string
      assignment_delimiter: equals
      description: Output device (e.g., png16m, jpeg, pdfwrite)
    - name: output
      cli: "-sOutputFile"
      type: file
      assignment_delimiter: equals
      description: Output file path
    - name: resolution
      cli: "-r"
      type: string
      assignment_delimiter: auto
      description: Resolution (e.g., 150, 300, or 600x600)
    flags:
    - name: quiet
      cli: "-q"
      default: false
      description: Quiet mode
    - name: batch
      cli: "-dBATCH"
      default: true
      description: Batch mode
    arguments:
    - name: inputs
      type: file
      required: false
      position: last
      variadic: true
      min: 1
      separator: " "
      description: Input file(s) to process
    standalone_executable: false
- name: windows
  display_name: Ghostscript on Windows
  platforms:
  - windows
  shells:
  - powershell
  - cmd
  option_style: single_dash_equals
  commands:
  - name: convert
    description: Convert PostScript or PDF to other formats
    usage: gswin64c [options] input-file
    options:
    - name: device
      cli: "-sDEVICE"
      type: string
      assignment_delimiter: equals
      description: Output device (e.g., png16m, jpeg, pdfwrite)
    - name: output
      cli: "-sOutputFile"
      type: file
      assignment_delimiter: equals
      description: Output file path
    - name: resolution
      cli: "-r"
      type: string
      assignment_delimiter: auto
      description: Resolution (e.g., 150, 300, or 600x600)
    flags:
    - name: quiet
      cli: "-q"
      default: false
      description: Quiet mode
    - name: batch
      cli: "-dBATCH"
      default: true
      description: Batch mode
    arguments:
    - name: inputs
      type: file
      required: false
      position: last
      variadic: true
      min: 1
      separator: " "
      description: Input file(s) to process
    standalone_executable: false
version_detection:
  command:
  - "--version"
  pattern: "(\\d+\\.\\d+)"
  modern_threshold: '9.0'
  source: command

---
ukiryu_schema: '1.0'
"$self": https://www.ukiryu.com/register/1.0/inkscape/1.0
name: inkscape
display_name: Inkscape Vector Graphics Editor
homepage: https://inkscape.org/
version: '1.0'
aliases:
- ink
profiles:
- name: modern_unix
  display_name: Modern Inkscape on Unix
  platforms:
  - macos
  - linux
  shells:
  - bash
  - zsh
  option_style: double_dash_equals
  commands:
  - name: export
    description: Export document to different format
    usage: inkscape [OPTIONS] input.svg
    options:
    - name: output
      cli: "--export-filename"
      type: file
      assignment_delimiter: equals
      description: Output filename
    - name: format
      cli: "--export-type"
      type: symbol
      assignment_delimiter: equals
      values:
      - svg
      - png
      - pdf
      description: Output format
    flags:
    - name: plain
      cli: "--export-plain-svg"
      default: false
      description: Remove Inkscape-specific attributes
    arguments:
    - name: inputs
      type: file
      required: false
      position: last
      variadic: true
      min: 1
      separator: " "
      description: Input file(s)
    use_env_vars:
    - headless
    standalone_executable: false
  env_var_sets:
    headless:
    - name: DISPLAY
      value: ''
      platforms:
      - macos
      - linux
      description: Disable display for headless operation
version_detection:
  command:
  - "--version"
  pattern: Inkscape (\d+\.\d+)
  modern_threshold: '1.0'
  source: command
